name: Siansa Beats (dev)
author: Siansa
description: For Siansa Dev: each song's loudness, how it starts and ends, similar albums and artists, as the Siansa plugin does, with its tempo, beats, bars and phrases from Siansa Beats (Beat This!). On install it takes what the Siansa plugin already measured.

versions.changelog: Stands on its own: measures loudness and fades and builds similar albums and artists itself, as the Siansa plugin does, and takes what that one already measured on install (nothing is measured again). The beat grids still come from Siansa Beats.
Adds each song's key and scale, as AudioMuse-AI analysed them, for Siansa Dev's smart blends.
Passes on Siansa Beats' lock-in points, bass, energy, drops and breakdowns, and sends song changes marked as bad in Siansa Dev to Siansa Beats' list.
First version: profiles from the Siansa plugin's measurements with the beat grids from Siansa Beats.
